import json, struct
d = json.load(open('out.json'))
lo = {int(k): v for k, v in d.items() if int(k) < 0x400000}
hi = {int(k): v for k, v in d.items() if int(k) >= 0x400000}
print("total:", len(d), "raw(<0x400000):", len(lo), "hi(>=0x400000):", len(hi))

# independent reference computation
data = open('a.out','rb').read()
phoff, phnum = struct.unpack_from('<QH', data, 0x20)[0], struct.unpack_from('<H', data, 0x38)[0]
segs = []
for i in range(phnum):
    o = 64 + i*56
    t, fl = struct.unpack_from('<II', data, o)
    if t != 1: continue
    off, va = struct.unpack_from('<QQ', data, o+8)
    fsz, msz = struct.unpack_from('<QQ', data, o+32)
    segs.append((off, va, fsz, msz))
print("segments:", [hex(x[1]) for x in segs])

exp = {}   # raw addr -> val
for off, va, fsz, msz in segs:
    for k in range(0, msz, 4):
        f = off + k
        exp[va + k] = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, f)[0] if f+4 <= off+fsz else 0
# raw full span with zero gaps
minv = min(s[1] for s in segs); maxv = max(s[1]+s[3] for s in segs)
span = {a: exp.get(a, 0) for a in range(minv, maxv, 4)}
hiexp = {a + 0x400000: v for a, v in exp.items()}

print("expected raw span words:", len(span), "got:", len(lo))
missing = set(span) - set(lo)
print("missing raw span addrs:", len(missing), sorted(hex(a) for a in list(missing))[:10])
bad = [a for a in lo if lo[a] != span[a]]
print("mismatched raw vals:", len(bad), bad[:10])
print("extra raw addrs:", len(set(lo) - set(span)))
print("expected hi words:", len(hiexp), "got:", len(hi))
badh = [a for a in hi if a in hiexp and hi[a] != hiexp[a]]
print("mismatched hi vals:", len(badh), badh[:10])
print("extra hi addrs:", len(set(hi) - set(hiexp)))
# spot checks
print("0x1060:", d.get("4192"), "expect", struct.unpack_from('<I', data, 0x1060)[0], "(endbr64)")
print("0x2000:", d.get("8192"), "expect", struct.unpack_from('<I', data, 0x2000)[0])
print("0x401060:", d.get("4200656+16777216"), d.get(str(0x1060+0x400000)))
print("bss 0x4010:", d.get("16400"), "bss 0x4014:", d.get("16404"), "bss hi:", d.get(str(0x404010)), d.get(str(0x404014)))
EOF
